Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGame
public class Game extends Object implements IGame
Core orchestrator of the game logic. Manages the state machine, turn order, deck handling, and the overarching domain rules.
